content:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Multiple containers on rwd-srv-prod-12 are reporting repeated OOM kills and CUDA driver errors over the last 6m. Investigate. :rotating_light:
Mina (eng-oncall): seeing the alerts, pulling logs now.
Mina (eng-oncall): quick summary — 503 spikes on /v1/generate for model redwood/llama-xl-paged at ~09:03 UTC, host rwd-srv-prod-12 showing container restarts.
Jasper (eng-runtime): on it. Which allocator are we running for that model? Paged-attn allocator + KV cache enabled?
Mina (eng-oncall): yes, paged-attn + KV cache at default prefix size 256.
Mina (eng-oncall): past 10m: 27 OOM kills, kernel dmesg shows repeated "Out of memory: Killed process" targeting inference worker. Also some CUDA error 719s.
Tara (support): customer impact — Support dashboard shows 12% of requests for org:acme-inc getting 5xx from hosted API during the spike. Raised a ticket to account manager.
Jasper (eng-runtime): paste logs, please. Also run pmap and free -m on the node if possible.
Mina (eng-oncall): attaching snippets:
```
09:02:44 kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 21453 (rwd-infer) total-vm:7543216kB, anon-rss:6324000kB, file-rss:0kB
09:03:01 rwd-infer[21453]: CUDA error 719: device-side assert triggered
09:03:05 rwd-infer[21453]: terminating due to OOM
kubectl logs rwd-infer-21453 -n rwd-prod | tail -n 40
  runtime: alloc chunk 0x7f2b... failed: no usable region
  allocator: paged_attention: fragmentation high: live_chunks=4321 free_chunks=1102
```

Mina (eng-oncall): pmap on the container cgroup: several large anonymous mappings pinned, roughly 6.1GB used by heap/cache.
Jasper (eng-runtime): looks like KV cache is fragmenting the paged allocator -> slow memory creep. We've seen this pattern: incremental allocations never returned to OS due to allocator freelist fragmentation, then CUDA allocations fail because device memory exhausted.
Jasper (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation steps we should run now:
- disable KV cache for the affected model to stop new cache population
- scale down concurrency for that model (max tokens in-flight)
- cordon & drain the node to move other pods off if instability continues
- apply emergency allocator compaction (lightweight GC) if available

Mina (eng-oncall): executing: `curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/admin/models/redwood/llama-xl-paged/config" -d '{"kv_cache_enabled":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'`
IncidentBot: Admin API request queued: config change for redwood/llama-xl-paged (request id abc123).
Mina (eng-oncall): scaling concurrency: `rwctl model set-concurrency redwood/llama-xl-paged --max-inflight 8`
Ops-Bot: Kubernetes drain scheduled: `kubectl drain rwd-srv-prod-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (will start in 30s).
Priya (eng-oncall): I can take node drain and do a rolling restart if required. Any objections?
Tara (support): keeping Acme updated: sent message "We're mitigating elevated errors, temporary performance degradation expected " and linking to status incident-4872.
Jasper (eng-runtime): while drain runs, run this diagnostic to confirm fragmentation cause:
```
echo "alloc stats" > /tmp/alloc.stats
cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/docker/<cid>/memory.stat | egrep 'cache|rss|mapped_file'
python tools/allocator_inspect.py --pid 21453 --dump-freelist > /tmp/freelist.dump
```
Jasper (eng-runtime): the allocator_inspect shows many small free segments, but large live_chunks preventing coalescing.
Mina (eng-oncall): drain completed. Node cordoned, pods rescheduled. Error rate dropped from 12% -> 2% within 6m.
Priya (eng-oncall): can we do a hot-patch to allocator to trigger periodic compaction? If not, recommend a rolling deploy of runtime with compaction flag.
Jasper (eng-runtime): I have a patch that introduces `--compact-freelist-interval=10m` which performs lock-held coalescing of free runs. I can cut a canary image and push to one AZ.
Mina (eng-oncall): what's the rollback plan if compaction causes latency blips?
Jasper (eng-runtime): rollback is fast: revert deployment to previous image, and we have traffic routing to fallback model variant (non-paged attention) ready as a failover. Also can re-enable KV cache after compaction if stable.
Tara (support): current customer impact: Acme shows 1.2% errors now, we've messaged them. No SLA breach yet but watching.
IncidentBot: Incident declared SEV2 (partial service disruption) at 2026-02-28T09:08:12Z.
Mina (eng-oncall): deploying canary runtime with compaction flag to pool-a (one host). Monitoring logs and p50/p95.
Jasper (eng-runtime): canary up. Initial metrics: memory footprints on canary are ~15% lower after compaction runs. No regression in latency for 95th percentile so far.
Mina (eng-oncall): continuing to watch – overall error rate holding at ~1.5%.
Priya (eng-oncall): I'll own the oncall for the next 8h. If memory spike recurs, revert KV cache off and route traffic to non-paged-attn variant.
Mina (eng-oncall): handoff: infra steps taken: KV cache disabled for redwood/llama-xl-paged, concurrency limit set to 8, rwd-srv-prod-12 drained and cordoned, canary runtime deployed with compaction flag.
Mina (eng-oncall): follow-ups (to be done in postmortem):
- root cause analysis: allocator freelist fragmentation triggered by KV eviction pattern under high prefix churn
- add background compaction or bigger slab sizes for paged allocator
- telemetry: add allocator free/used histograms to console per model
- run a long-running repro test with high prefix churn to validate fixer

Tara (support): prepping customer-facing incident note. Will include mitigation steps and ETA for full resolution.
Jasper (eng-runtime): opened PR #4321: "paged-attn: add periodic freelist compaction + telemetry" — canary passed initial checks.
Priya (eng-oncall): marking incident as mitigated for now. Will escalate to SEV1 if error rate jumps >5% again.
IncidentBot: Incident mitigated at 2026-02-28T12:30:00Z, status: monitoring.
Mina (eng-oncall): thanks team. I'll start the postmortem doc tomorrow with timeline + action items.
Priya (eng-oncall): taking over. Ping me if anything pops. :wave:
